sections.title: Project and source code
sections.body:
An independent Android adaptation maintained by rbabbit, based on Warzone 2100 4.7.0. Original authors retain their copyrights. These project links do not imply endorsement.

The complete source archive and build instructions accompany this test APK. The Android repository is currently private; GitHub authorization is required to access it.

sections.title: Warzone 2100 licence
sections.body: The original Warzone source and data are released under the GNU General Public License, version 2 or, at your option, any later version, with the linking exception in the original licence statement. Certain components and assets use separate licences listed in the non-GPL notices.

links.label: Original licence statement and linking exception

documents.title: Warzone licence statement and linking exception

sections.title: Game content, maps and music
sections.body: Game content retains the original Warzone and contributor notices. The soundtrack includes Martin Severn’s original music and the separately credited Legacy, Aftermath and Reclamation albums. Consult each album’s exact notice for its applicable GPL and Creative Commons options.

links.label: Official soundtrack source and album notices

sections.title: Survival and More Fortress
sections.body:
The supplied Survival scripts match the GPL-2.0-or-later Tower Defense project by aco4. TDN2 and Wave map metadata credits arc and declares CC0.

More Fortress 0.6 did not include a licence declaration in the supplied archives. Its redistribution permission remains unresolved; this page does not assign it a licence or grant additional rights.

documents.title: Tower Defense project README and licence declaration

sections.title: Fonts and interface icons
sections.body: Oswald is used under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The game also includes DejaVu and retained font notices. Phosphor interface icons are MIT licensed. Copyright statements and permissions are reproduced below.

documents.title: Oswald SIL Open Font License — full text

sections.title: Replay viewer
sections.body: The focused replay viewer is adapted from MaWay2000/boha by MM. Its web code and mapmaker are MIT licensed, with Three.js under the MIT licence. Warzone models, terrain and effects retain their original terms. Public match data and replay records are provided by Retropaganda.

links.label: Replay viewer source and MIT licence

sections.title: Native engine components
sections.body: The retained Warzone build sources include third-party libraries with their own notices, including FreeType, HarfBuzz, SDL, PhysFS, libsodium, QuickJS, libjpeg-turbo, zlib, libzip and Xiph codecs. The source notice collection also retains optional and build-source notices; inclusion in that collection does not mean every component is active at runtime.

sections.title: Android open-source components
sections.body: AndroidX WebKit and related AndroidX libraries, Kotlin, Coroutines, Guava and annotation libraries carry their own Apache, MIT, BSD and Boost notices. The dependency inventory lists the versions included in this APK.

sections.title: Cronet and Chromium
sections.body: Cronet 500.1.0 provides the Android network transport. Its complete bundled Chromium and third-party notice is retained separately.

sections.title: Google Play Games Services
sections.body: The optional Google Play Games integration includes Google's Play Games Services SDK for Android, com.google.android.gms:play-services-games-v2:22.1.0. Google's SDK and service have their own applicable terms; the Warzone GPL notice does not relicense them. The integration is disabled by default and requires separate Google Play Console configuration and an explicit connection.

links.label: Official Google Play Games Android SDK documentation

sections.title: Additional licence references
sections.body: These reference links supplement the original component notices above. The terms identified in each original notice apply to that component.

sections.title: Challenge maps and Dumbot25a
sections.body: Challenge includes ten authored maps and the supplied Dumbot25a opponent. The notice records map authors and declared licences, original-source identities and the limited Challenge adapter. Some supplied archives contain no licence declaration.

documents.title: Challenge asset credits and supplied licence declarations

sections.title: Additional Maps opponents
sections.body: Additional opponents retain their original source notices. Wally is by Stefano Brandi under GPL-2.0-or-later. RatBot and its personalities are by Subsentient; the supplied source explicitly dedicates RatBot to the public domain. Dumbot25a retains the existing Challenge source provenance. Original sources and the small native compatibility and difficulty adapters accompany this edition.
